problem_statement: When a Key ID Mode 0 MAC frame is received by a Thread node, the node attempts to decrypt it using the KEK (Key Establishment Key) even if no KEK has been configured. A node should instead reject such a frame with a security error when no KEK has been set, to avoid decrypting with an uninitialized key. The KeyManager must expose an IsKekSet() query that reports whether a KEK has been configured, so the receiver can validate this before proceeding with decryption. The test verifies that the key-set state starts as false, transitions to true after the KEK is set, and is correctly tracked.
